name: Saud White Beach
short_description: A long stretch of powdery white sand and calm turquoise water along Pagudpud's northern coastline.

name: Blue Lagoon (Maira-ira Cove)
short_description: A sheltered cove with clear blue water framed by forested cliffs and limestone outcrops.

name: Patapat Viaduct
short_description: A coastal viaduct hugging the cliffs of the Cordillera foothills with sweeping views of the West Philippine Sea.

name: Kabigan Falls
short_description: A tall forest waterfall reached through a gentle riverside trek from the village jump-off point.

name: Bantay Abot Cave
short_description: A natural rock arch and cave opening onto a rugged coastal shoreline along the Pagudpud road.

name: Agua Grande River Park
short_description: A river-and-sea meeting point with picnic cottages, shallow pools, and rock formations beside the highway.

name: Bangui Windmills (Wind Farm Viewdeck)
short_description: A row of towering wind turbines arrayed along the Bangui Bay shoreline with a dedicated viewing deck.

name: Sentinela Hill Viewpoint
short_description: A hilltop overlook commanding a wide panorama of Bangui Bay, the wind farm, and the northern coastline.

name: Bangui Artisan Inabel & Coastal Cafe
short_description: A roadside artisan stop pairing handwoven Abel Iloko textiles with locally roasted coffee and coastal views.

name: Kapurpurawan Rock Formation
short_description: Sculpted white limestone formations overlooking the sea, reached by a short trail through coastal grassland.

name: Cape Bojeador Lighthouse (Burgos Lighthouse)
short_description: A Spanish-colonial-era lighthouse on a hilltop overlooking the northern coast and West Philippine Sea.

name: Tanap Avis Falls
short_description: A secluded multi-tiered waterfall in the Burgos uplands reached by a moderate forest trek.

name: Burgos Dragonfruit Farm
short_description: A working dragonfruit plantation offering farm walks, fruit tasting, and agricultural demonstrations.

name: Pasuquin Salt-Making Stalls (Salinas)
short_description: Traditional seaside salt beds where salt is still harvested by hand and sold along the highway.

name: Pasuquin Bakery (Original Soft Biscocho)
short_description: A long-standing local bakery renowned for its soft, buttery biscocho sold fresh along the highway.

name: Dumalneg Isneg Cultural Heritage Center & Bolo River Eco-Trail
short_description: A community heritage center preserving Isneg culture, paired with an eco-trail along the Bolo River basin.

name: Araruang (Kilang) Falls
short_description: A remote upland waterfall in Dumalneg reached by a rough trail through forest and river crossings.

name: Anuplig Falls
short_description: A tall cascade set in the forested mountains of Adams, reached by a guided upland trek.

name: Lovers Peak (Mount Palemlem) Eco-Trail
short_description: A ridge trail and viewpoint above Adams offering panoramic mountain and river-valley scenery.

name: Adams Bugnay Wine & Hanging Bridge Experience
short_description: A community experience featuring native bugnay fruit wine production and a river hanging-bridge crossing.

name: La Paz Sand Dunes (4x4 & Sandboarding)
short_description: Coastal sand dunes offering 4x4 rides, sandboarding, and wide sunset views near Laoag City.

name: Sinking Bell Tower & St. William's Cathedral
short_description: Laoag's iconic leaning bell tower and Spanish-era cathedral in the heart of the city center.

name: Museo Ilocos Norte
short_description: A provincial museum housed in a historic building, showcasing Ilocano heritage, crafts, and lifeways.

name: Aurora Park & Tobacco Monopoly Monument
short_description: A central public plaza anchored by the Tobacco Monopoly Monument, a reminder of the province's colonial economy.

name: La Preciosa Restaurant
short_description: A well-known Laoag dining institution serving classic Ilocano dishes and local specialties.

name: Dawang's Eatery
short_description: A casual local eatery serving affordable Ilocano home-style meals favored by residents.

name: Valdes-Lardizabal Ancestral House
short_description: A preserved Spanish-era ancestral house showcasing the architecture and heirloom collections of a prominent local family.

name: San Nicolas Damili (Red Clay Terra Cotta Pottery) Village
short_description: A traditional pottery village where artisans shape red-clay damili cookware and decorative terracotta by hand.

name: San Nicolas Heritage Plaza & Ilocano Dining
short_description: A town-center dining stop near the heritage plaza serving local Ilocano plates and merienda.

name: Bacarra Domeless Bell Tower & St. Andrew Parish Church
short_description: The famous domeless bell tower of Bacarra, standing beside the Spanish-era St. Andrew Parish Church.

name: Museo de Bacarra
short_description: A small local museum preserving relics, photographs, and artifacts of Bacarra heritage.

name: Bacarra Traditional Miki Eatery
short_description: A local eatery serving Bacarra-style miki noodle soup and other Ilocano comfort dishes.

name: Santa Monica Parish Church & Convent
short_description: A red-brick Spanish-era church and convent complex known for its distinctive heritage architecture.

name: Edralin Ancestral House (Marcos Sr. Birthplace Museum)
short_description: The restored ancestral house and birthplace museum of former President Ferdinand E. Marcos Sr.

name: Sarrat Binakol Weaving & Riverbank Park
short_description: A community weaving center for Binakol textiles set beside a relaxing riverbank park.

name: Umok ni Siwawer Eco-Adventure Park & Vintar Dam Viewdeck
short_description: A riverside eco-adventure park with a dam viewdeck, picnic areas, and gentle nature trails.

name: Vintar Highland River Picnic Grounds
short_description: Cool upland river picnic grounds on the edge of the Vintar highlands, ideal for family outings.

name: Paoay Church (San Agustin Church)
short_description: A UNESCO World Heritage Earthquake Baroque church built from coral stone and brick.

verification_metadata.source_name: UNESCO World Heritage Registry / Provincial Tourism

name: Malacañang of the North
short_description: A lakeside former presidential rest house turned museum overlooking Paoay Lake.

name: Culili Point Paoay Sand Dunes
short_description: Rolling coastal sand dunes offering 4x4 rides, sandboarding, and dramatic sunset photo spots.

name: Paoay Lake National Park
short_description: A protected lake basin with scenic shorelines, birdlife, and views toward the Paoay church.

name: Nagbacalan Loomweaving Multi-Purpose Cooperative
short_description: A community cooperative where visitors can watch Abel Iloko handloom weaving and buy textiles.

name: Herencia Cafe (Pinakbet Pizza)
short_description: A heritage-inspired cafe near Paoay Church known for its Ilocano fusion dishes such as pinakbet pizza.

name: Batac Riverside Empanadaan
short_description: A cluster of riverside stalls serving authentic Batac empanada and miki to locals and visitors.

name: Museo ni Ferdinand E. Marcos
short_description: A museum preserving memorabilia and documents related to former President Ferdinand E. Marcos.

name: Gregorio Aglipay National Shrine
short_description: A national shrine honoring Gregorio Aglipay, founder of the Philippine Independent Church.

name: Artemio Ricarte National Shrine & Park
short_description: A shrine and park commemorating Ilocano revolutionary general Artemio Ricarte.

name: Pangil Coral Rock Gardens
short_description: Tide-exposed coral rock formations and natural pools along the Currimao shoreline.

name: Gaang Beach & Cove
short_description: A quiet cove with dark sand, rocky outcrops, and sunset views along the southern coast.

name: Magdalena Gamayo Inabel Weaving Center
short_description: The workshop of National Living Treasure Magdalena Gamayo, showcasing masterful Abel Iloko weaving.

name: Pinili Garlic Farmers Trading & Monument
short_description: A local garlic trading area and monument celebrating Pinili as a major garlic-producing town.

name: Juan Luna Shrine
short_description: A reconstructed ancestral house honoring painter Juan Luna, a national hero of the Philippines.

name: La Virgen Milagrosa Chapel & Badoc Island Viewpoint
short_description: A coastal chapel and viewpoint overlooking Badoc Island and the West Philippine Sea.

name: Badoc Saint John the Baptist Parish Church
short_description: A Spanish-era parish church in Badoc with notable colonial-era architecture and religious heritage.

name: Ruins of San Jose Parish Church (Bantay Kampana)
short_description: The imposing brick-and-coral ruins of an old parish church, among the largest church ruins in Ilocos.

name: Madongan Dam & Dingras Rice Granary Heritage Plaza
short_description: An irrigation dam and rice-granary heritage plaza highlighting Dingras as the rice bowl of the province.

name: Piddig Basi Revolution Historical Shrine & St. Anne Parish Church
short_description: A historical shrine commemorating the 1807 Basi Revolt, beside the Spanish-era St. Anne Parish Church.

name: Piddig Convergence Organic Coffee Plantation
short_description: A community organic coffee and native delicacy enterprise producing basi and tinubong.

name: Solsona-Apayao Road Scenic Highland Viewdeck
short_description: A mountain viewdeck along the Solsona-Apayao road with sweeping Cordillera foothill panoramas.

name: Karinking River Picnic Grounds
short_description: Cool river picnic grounds with shallow pools and shaded cottages in the Solsona uplands.

name: Solsona Eco-Agri Tourism Park
short_description: An agri-tourism park featuring farm plots, orchard trails, and upland eco-landscapes.

name: Magnuang Highland Eco-Trail & Durian Agro Farm
short_description: A rugged highland eco-trail through forest and agro-forestry plots in the Cordillera foothills of Carasi.

name: Carasi Municipal Viewdeck (Cordillera Foothills)
short_description: A municipal viewpoint overlooking the rolling Cordillera foothills surrounding Carasi.

name: Sinamar / Banna Eco-Tourism Park
short_description: A community eco-tourism park with stream trails, picnic areas, and agro-forestry scenery.

name: Crispina Marcos Valdez Cultural Center & Plaza
short_description: A local cultural center and plaza preserving the history and community heritage of Banna (Espiritu).

name: Marcos Municipal Agro-Forestry Park & Daquioag Creek Viewpoint
short_description: An agro-forestry park and creek viewpoint showcasing the upland agricultural landscape of Marcos.

name: St. Anthony of Padua Parish & Town Plaza
short_description: The town parish church and central plaza anchoring the civic and religious life of Marcos.

name: Nueva Era Eco-Cultural Park & Tingguian Tribal Museum/Village
short_description: A cultural park and tribal museum/village interpreting the heritage of the Tingguian people.

name: Alingking Forest Spring Park
short_description: A forested spring park in the Nueva Era uplands with cool water and shaded nature trails.
